                第一章   总   则

  第一条    为维护正常的教育教学秩序和生活秩序，保障学生
合法权益，培养德智体美劳全面发展的社会主义建设者和接班
人，根据《普通高等学校学生管理规定》
                 《浙江大学章程》，结合
学校实际，制定本办法。
  第二条    本办法适用于在我校接受普通高等学历教育的本
科生和研究生（以下统称学生）。
  第三条    本办法中的违纪行为，是指违反宪法、法律、法规、
规章或者学校各项管理制度的行为。
  第四条    学校对学生的处分，应当坚持教育与惩戒相结合，
与学生违纪行为的性质和过错的严重程度相适应。学校对学生的
处分，应当做到证据充分、依据明确、定性准确、程序正当、处
分适当。
  第五条    学生对违纪处分有按程序陈述、申辩、申诉等权利。

          第二章   纪律处分种类和适用

  第六条    对有违纪行为的学生，学校应当给予批评教育，并
可视情节轻重，给予如下纪律处分：

basis.evidenceSnippet: 1. Principle of Human Authorship: Artificial intelligence (AI) or large language models (LLMs) cannot be listed as an author or co-author of a manuscript. Authorship and order of authors must be predicated on substantive intellectual contributions. AI tools are incapable of assuming legal or ethical responsibility for the originality, integrity, or validity of the work.1

2. Authorial Final Responsibility: Authors bear full responsibility for the entire content of their work, including any portions generated with the assistance of AI. Authors must rigorously review AI-generated output for accuracy, originality, and compliance with disciplinary standards. They are accountable for any issues such as plagiarism, data fabrication, or breach of confidentiality arising from the use of AI.2

3. Obligation for Transparent Disclosure: Any substantive use of generative AI tools during the preparation of a manuscript must be disclosed explicitly and in detail within the paper. Failure to disclose such use, if discovered, will be treated as a form of academic misconduct.

Authors who have used generative AI tools in the preparation of their manuscript must include a statement in the “Methods” section (if applicable) or immediately preceding the “Acknowledgements” section. The disclosure must follow the format below.

1. Permitted Use (Requiring Disclosure):
		
  •  Using AI tools for language polishing and stylistic refinement to improve the manuscript’s readability.
		
  •  Assisting with literature review and formatting of references, provided authors verify the original sources.3

2. Prohibited Use (Strictly Forbidden):
		
  •  AI cannot be listed as an author, nor may it be used to generate original intellectual contributions such as research hypotheses, core conclusions, or novel insights.
		
  •  The use of AI tools to generate, manipulate, or falsify research data, experimental records, or clinical observations is strictly forbidden.
		
  •  The use of generative AI tools (e.g., Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion) to create or alter key research images (e.g., blots, micrographs, clinical images) is strictly forbidden.1,2

决定”的复查意见。

处理决定”或“建议变更原处理决定”的复查意见：

     （二）处理决定适用依据错误的；
     （三）处理决定程序不当的；

处理决定的机构。复查意见建议撤销或变更原学校处理决定的，

决定，不得加重对申诉人的处理。

补正的申请之日起计算。

方式送达。
  第十三条   申诉人对复查结论有异议的，在接到申诉复查意
见之日起 15 日内，可以向浙江省教育厅提出书面申诉。

basis.evidenceSnippet: 1. Principle of Human Authorship: Artificial intelligence (AI) or large language models (LLMs) cannot be listed as an author or co-author of a manuscript. Authorship and order of authors must be predicated on substantive intellectual contributions. AI tools are incapable of assuming legal or ethical responsibility for the originality, integrity, or validity of the work.1

2. Authorial Final Responsibility: Authors bear full responsibility for the entire content of their work, including any portions generated with the assistance of AI. Authors must rigorously review AI-generated output for accuracy, originality, and compliance with disciplinary standards. They are accountable for any issues such as plagiarism, data fabrication, or breach of confidentiality arising from the use of AI.2

3. Obligation for Transparent Disclosure: Any substantive use of generative AI tools during the preparation of a manuscript must be disclosed explicitly and in detail within the paper. Failure to disclose such use, if discovered, will be treated as a form of academic misconduct.

Authors who have used generative AI tools in the preparation of their manuscript must include a statement in the “Methods” section (if applicable) or immediately preceding the “Acknowledgements” section. The disclosure must follow the format below.

1. Permitted Use (Requiring Disclosure):
		
  •  Using AI tools for language polishing and stylistic refinement to improve the manuscript’s readability.
		
  •  Assisting with literature review and formatting of references, provided authors verify the original sources.3

2. Prohibited Use (Strictly Forbidden):
		
  •  AI cannot be listed as an author, nor may it be used to generate original intellectual contributions such as research hypotheses, core conclusions, or novel insights.
		
  •  The use of AI tools to generate, manipulate, or falsify research data, experimental records, or clinical observations is strictly forbidden.
		
  •  The use of generative AI tools (e.g., Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion) to create or alter key research images (e.g., blots, micrographs, clinical images) is strictly forbidden.1,2

  第二条    在浙江大学接受普通高等学历教育的本科生和研
究生，因对学校给予的取消入学资格、取消学籍、退学或者违纪

部、党委研究生工作部、校团委、本科生院、研究生院等有关部
门负责人，以及教师代表、学生代表和法律专业人士等组成。
